≻.justification: The forward morphism driving the system from a split state toward re-fusion, encoding the kinetic barrier.

≺.justification: The reverse morphism representing the refusal to accept the split, forcing the system back toward identity.

⋈.justification: The composition of operations that links the split, refusal, and re-fusion into a coherent process.

⊙.justification: The identity element where the system recognizes itself as its own address within the Belnap lattice.

∈.justification: The co-multiplication that splits the informational structure into two distinct arms: one affirming the split, one refusing it.

∋.justification: The multiplication that reconstitutes the split arms into a single resolved state, preserving identity through the refusal.

⊤.justification: The constructive truth arm where the split is accepted as a valid local transformation.

⊥.justification: The constructive falsity arm where the split is rejected, triggering the return to identity.

⊞.justification: The simultaneous holding of both split and refusal, creating a contradiction that is resolved as a stable B-state.

⊡.justification: The permanent, append-only record of the non-trivial integer winding number that prevents deformation to a trivial state.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the pre-structural void, the empty set from which the informational hierarchy will emerge.
Split the closed informational structure into two arms: one affirming the local division, one refusing it.
Affirm the split as a valid local transformation within the informational hierarchy.
Drive the affirmative arm forward toward a potential re-fusion state.
Refuse the split as a valid global transformation, triggering the return to identity.
Reverse the direction of the refusal arm, forcing the system back toward the closed loop.
Compose the forward and reverse morphisms into a sequential interaction grammar.
Hold both the split and the refusal simultaneously, creating a paradice state.
Reconstitute the split and refusal arms into a single resolved state, preserving identity.
Recognize the system as its own address within the Belnap lattice, completing the self-imscription.
Record the non-trivial integer winding number as a permanent, append-only invariant.
Chain the winding invariant with the self-imscription to enforce the closed loop.
Anchor the entire system within the closed informational boundary, ensuring no leakage.
Re-assert the self-imscription to maintain the system's self-describing nature.
Record the final state of the system as a permanent witness to the self-fusion law.
